groups.name: 轮廓与配色细化
groups.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished wide landscape designer exploration board for loppi titled exactly '薄荷团子 / 形象细化'. Reference image role: character identity and pixel style reference ONLY. Use the mint-green rabbit at the upper left as the source of identity. Preserve its wide rounded-square face, compact seated mint body, ivory muzzle connected visually to ivory chest, peach inner ears and tiny peach nose, two small dark forest-green eyes, thick dark forest-green square-pixel outline, short broad ears, tiny hands and broad tucked feet. This is loppi's chosen mascot '薄荷团子'. It must look like this rabbit, not another animal or the cream/lavender rabbits. Professional adult productivity companion, quiet cute warmth, no baby decorations. Crisp square-pixel artwork, economical flat color blocks, stepped outlines, no noisy textures, no blurred character edges. No headphones, microphones, carrots, recording indicators, timers, waveforms, Z letters, hearts, confetti or costumes.
White-warm ivory editorial background. Present FOUR candidate refinements in a clean 2x2 grid, generous whitespace, each cell includes a LARGE upright listening rabbit and a smaller sleeping pose of the exact same variant. Keep all four unmistakably the same selected mascot, vary carefully defined proportions and finishing rather than totally redesigning.
B1 '原味薄荷': closest to the reference, mid mint fur and dark forest outline, roughly 24x30 logical pixel grid, broad ivory muzzle and chest, broad short ears, balanced wide head.
B2 '柔和奶绿': lighter dusty mint, gentler muted green outline, slightly softer stepped cheeks and shorter body, same broad ears and ivory muzzle; ensure contrast remains legible.
B3 '紧凑像素': the same rabbit reduced to an economical 20x26 logical pixel grid with fewer shades, strong outline, clear small eyes, ears shortened by about 10 percent, designed for a 30 px high notch entry; not a new logo or just a head.
B4 '好奇折耳': same B1 palette and body, one short ear tip with a subtle permanent outward fold as a signature, slightly curious small-eyed expression with NO grin; sleep relaxes both ears.
Each group only labels B1/B2/B3/B4 and exact short Chinese name. At bottom include same-size small previews on charcoal strips to judge contrast. No app icons on this sheet. Make variations visible but restrained. No paragraphs. Show crafted pixel discipline. Sleeping closes eyes and relaxes ears, keeping exactly the same base footprint as listening.

groups.name: 动作与表情拓展
groups.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A landscape professional character-state design board, heading exactly '薄荷团子 / 小动作'. Reference image role: character identity and pixel style reference ONLY. Use the mint-green rabbit at the upper left as the source of identity. Preserve its wide rounded-square face, compact seated mint body, ivory muzzle connected visually to ivory chest, peach inner ears and tiny peach nose, two small dark forest-green eyes, thick dark forest-green square-pixel outline, short broad ears, tiny hands and broad tucked feet. This is loppi's chosen mascot '薄荷团子'. It must look like this rabbit, not another animal or the cream/lavender rabbits. Professional adult productivity companion, quiet cute warmth, no baby decorations. Crisp square-pixel artwork, economical flat color blocks, stepped outlines, no noisy textures, no blurred character edges. No headphones, microphones, carrots, recording indicators, timers, waveforms, Z letters, hearts, confetti or costumes.
Preserve the original B1 identity from reference, do not adopt newly invented variants. Warm ivory background, generous whitespace, no complicated UI. Show eight full-body states of the SAME rabbit in a tidy 4-column by 2-row grid, each state large enough to read with precise tiny Chinese label. 1 '倾听': original upright attentive neutral pose. 2 '呼吸': the same planted feet and head position, chest softly expanded by one logical pixel, no jumping. 3 '睡觉': closed eyes, short ears gently bent outward, body softly settled with feet unchanged. 4 '睡眠呼吸': same sleeping identity, smallest chest expansion, no Z. 5 '看向你': a slight curious head tilt and one ear swivel toward the viewer, friendly not exaggerated. 6 '点头确认': gentle small chin dip and brief closed smiling eyes, keep small facial features, no smile-mouth or props. 7 '小伸展': awakening with hands stretching slightly outward and ears upright, seated feet stay planted, no jump. 8 '抬爪回应': lift ONE little paw in a restrained wave, not both arms, same body.
All states share exact fur markings, palette, pixel scale, total scale and grounded baseline; make action differences readable without cartoon frenzy. These are illustrative animation key poses, not a claim of executable animation. Use pure pixel shapes and limited colors, no motion streaks or external attention marks. No icon studies on this board, no explanatory copy.

groups.name: APP 图标样式探索
groups.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / product-mockup. A premium app icon exploration board titled exactly '薄荷团子 / APP 图标'. Reference image role: character identity and pixel style reference ONLY. Use the mint-green rabbit at the upper left as the source of identity. Preserve its wide rounded-square face, compact seated mint body, ivory muzzle connected visually to ivory chest, peach inner ears and tiny peach nose, two small dark forest-green eyes, thick dark forest-green square-pixel outline, short broad ears, tiny hands and broad tucked feet. This is loppi's chosen mascot '薄荷团子'. It must look like this rabbit, not another animal or the cream/lavender rabbits. Professional adult productivity companion, quiet cute warmth, no baby decorations. Crisp square-pixel artwork, economical flat color blocks, stepped outlines, no noisy textures, no blurred character edges. No headphones, microphones, carrots, recording indicators, timers, waveforms, Z letters, hearts, confetti or costumes.
Warm neutral background, landscape composition. Six large rounded-square APP ICON tiles in a 3-column x 2-row evenly spaced grid. The rabbit inside each tile always remains recognizably the same mint pixel character, same eyes, nose and cream muzzle; do not turn the rabbit into a smooth vector or a different 3D bunny. Use bold enough face and ear silhouette to be readable as a small app icon. Vary framing and the TILE finish:
I1 '奶油正脸': flat warm cream tile, oversized mint pixel rabbit face plus broad ears, centered, face fills frame without clipping ears.
I2 '深绿正脸': deep forest green flat tile, same mint/cream head and ears, strong dark-background separation, restrained outline adjusted only for contrast.
I3 '薄荷全身': very pale mint tile, centered full-body compact seated rabbit, strong silhouette and generous margins, no effects.
I4 '折耳近景': cream tile, same rabbit head in subtle three-quarter orientation with one small folded ear, still pixel-built, gentle curious eye direction, no elaborate detail.
I5 '像素浮雕': warm cream satin tile with shallow raised square-pixel relief made from the same mint and ivory rabbit head design, subtle depth and soft cast shadow from the physical relief, not photoreal fur, no gloss; recognizable as crafted pixel sculpture.
I6 '双色简化': forest-green tile, simplified ivory and mint pixel rabbit head silhouette with the same eye spacing and tiny peach nose, fewest details, large and bold.
Tiles may have subtle realistic surface highlights only where specified, but the graphic identity must match. Labels only I1..I6 and exact names below; no desktop screenshot, no phones, no extra logos, no wordmark within icons. Small duplicate row beneath each large icon can demonstrate reduced size, but do not clutter. High craft, calm mint/cream/forest brand family.

groups.name: 透明角色试样
groups.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character pose starter strip. Reference image role: character identity and pixel style reference ONLY. Use the mint-green rabbit at the upper left as the source of identity. Preserve its wide rounded-square face, compact seated mint body, ivory muzzle connected visually to ivory chest, peach inner ears and tiny peach nose, two small dark forest-green eyes, thick dark forest-green square-pixel outline, short broad ears, tiny hands and broad tucked feet. Crisp square-pixel artwork, economical flat color blocks, stepped outlines, no noisy textures, no blurred character edges. No headphones, microphones, carrots, recording indicators, timers, waveforms, Z letters, hearts, confetti or costumes.
Generate a TRUE TRANSPARENT background image, NO board, no text, no labels, no tile, no ground shadow, no decorative texture, no boundary frames. Four equally sized rabbits in one horizontal row, generous transparent separation and complete uncropped ears/paws. Use the EXACT original B1 rabbit identity and palette from the reference. From left to right: neutral upright listening; sleeping with closed eyes and ears folded softly outward; gentle curious head tilt with one ear turned; seated one-paw small acknowledgement wave. Transparent PNG cutouts only; alpha background, not checkerboard drawn into the picture. These are exploratory source poses, not a full final animation sheet.

notes: 图中呼吸与睡眠呼吸是关键姿态，不是已经生成的循环动画。
透明试样含倾听、睡觉、歪头、抬爪四姿态，已有真透明背景，需选定后规范网格与颜色并分拆生产资源。
